description.en: The 5-inch multirotor propeller class with a 5 mm hub hole that seats on an M5 motor shaft and is clamped by a nut.
description.es: La clase de hélice de multirrotor de 5 pulgadas con agujero de cubo de 5 mm que asienta en una flecha de motor M5 y se sujeta con tuerca.
description.fr: La classe d'hélice de multirotor de 5 pouces avec un trou de moyeu de 5 mm qui se pose sur un arbre moteur M5 et se serre par un écrou.
description.pt: A classe de hélice de multirrotor de 5 polegadas com furo de cubo de 5 mm que assenta num eixo de motor M5 e é presa por uma porca.

sources.title: HQProp 5X4.3X3 V1S poly carbonate propeller
sources.supports: 5 in diameter, 4.3 in pitch, 3 blades, hub Ø13.2 mm × 7 mm thick, 5 mm shaft hole, 3.81 g, polycarbonate

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the hub's bottom face (the face that seats on the motor), on the rotation axis. +z runs up through the hub to its top face at z = 7. +x is an arbitrary radial reference.

interfaces.note: Female: the hub receives the motor shaft. Symmetry 0: the propeller's angle on the shaft is free.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry: diameter and hub hole are the shared facts; pitch, blade count, hub size and mass are those of the cited HQProp model.
